_notes: Hand-authored bag catalog - the exception to this project's usual procedural-item rule (see LootGenerator). Bags are a small, fixed, named set, not something that benefits from procedural stat rolls the way armor/weapons do - a bag's only stat is bag_capacity. slot is the generic 'bag' PAIRED_SLOTS key (entities/equipment.py) so any of these fills whichever of bag1-bag4 is open, same convention as 'ring'/'trinket'. icon_id points at assets/icons/bags/<icon_id>.png (IconRenderer.BAG_ICON_DIR) - real WoW Classic icon art (Kyle's 'WoW Vanilla/Classic Icon Pack' upload, INV_Misc_Bag_* series), replacing an earlier hand-cropped fan-art sheet. Capacity/rarity/required_level tiered low-to-high roughly matching WoW's own bag progression, assigned by each icon's visual grandeur - plain sacks read as starter tier, the rune-etched/locked ones read as top tier.
